display_name: 原F跨RX50：跨RX难正对与同RX近异类的特征间隔
description: One new source-driven margin candidate on original F+CROSS_RX50, joint160 only. Fixed native recipe/noSat/clean. Reuse three prior-fixed matching BASE sources and target predictions; no baseline retraining.
aliases: F crossRX RX matched angular margin
authorization: Active user worse-transmitter feature-learning goal; local, no satellite augmentation/test, default head joint. Source feature geometry motivates a generic all-class margin, no target class-specific rule.

code.environment: Verified native Windows base Python3.10/PyTorch2.10+cu128; direct base interpreter; FP32/noTF32

data.representation: Original native received residual/post_sync/noeq, center crop/RMS normalized256 IQ; SAME validated mmap cache; native eq_i/sig_i/base_index restored by opaque physicalID join

roles.L_s: 6300 original visible source labels, randomL128 drop_last; ordinary augmentation; original native two RDrop forwards
roles.U_s: 56700 TX hidden; original U256 and batch_neighbor/ownEMA recipe during17U epochs; no new U feature objective
roles.V: 27000 no-update health and source-only fixed expansion; prior3model sourceV risk calibrates uniform class-weight formula

data.capsule_id: existing VALIDATED_ONCE Phase1 capsule manifest; reuse unchanged
data.split_id: original registered source/target physical split; reuse unchanged

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen default-head ManySig clean target168000 accuracy/MacroF1/perTX/RX/day; exposed benchmark; no independent blind/Phase2/satellite claim

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Existing source READY/EXACT_MATCH manifest reused; original role cache and native temporal metadata, current same-run initialization/source_frozen/native checkpoint args
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: New candidate/ownEMA starts from scratch, no inherited state. Existing BASE final50 checkpoint used only in discarded no-query verification. Matching BASE training/predictions reused for comparison, never loaded into candidate initialization.

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU0 max3 total source/predict workers across owners, freeRAM>=4.5GiB; CPU score max1 across this/current original50 run via CIM; preserve all healthy tasks
execution.launch_command: LOCAL_BASE_PYTHON -X utf8 -u -m experiments.cvs_f_rxmargin50.driver --profile LOCAL_PROFILE --metadata LOCAL_SOURCE_NATIVE_GATE_METADATA_R02 --base LOCAL_RUN/20261019-phase1-FcrossRX-RXmargin-e50-clean-local-m1-r01 --reference-base LOCAL_RUN/20261019-phase1-FcrossRX-TXrisk-geometry-e50-clean-local-m4-r01 --commit RELEASE_COMMIT --max-workers 3
execution.stop_rule: Role/provenance/config/output conflicts, nonfinite loss/gradient, incomplete native budget/EMA/Sinc/feature scope or failed worker stop new dispatch; preserve outputs and other healthy workers; no automatic or performance-based retries

metric_names: paired seed differences and sampleSD/positive counts
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Frozen same-row final50 default head; reused matching BASE predictions from parent run
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent CPU truth-last only after row clean predictions fixed

rows.method: Original F+CROSS_RX50 plus RX-matched joint160 angular margin
rows.purpose: Initial source-driven fixed falsification with reused matching BASE
rows.seed_notes: Original native model/augmentation and random L/U sampler; fixed original source partition392005; clean evaluation deterministic, no new channel randomness

optimizer.weight_decay: q -= alpha lambda (q+p0/s); AdamW q decay0
optimizer.native_cosine_schedule: Original alpha cosine; one fixed mapping immediately before each actual step

source_feature_objective.descriptor: channel time mean/population std, current L-batch detached standardization floor1e-4, sampleL2 eps1e-4
source_feature_objective.negative: otherTX only; sameTX sameRX excluded in CROSS_RX denominator
source_feature_objective.two_forward_policy: Mean of first/second losses, each mean of shallow/middle; reuse original actual augmented L IQ and RDrop forwards
source_feature_objective.invalid_anchor: Exclude anchors without positive or otherTX negative; finite zero if none; sampler unchanged
source_feature_objective.U: Original oldgate/ownEMA/cos untouched; no U TX labels or added U feature loss

additional_joint160.reduction: mean per class, then classes; hinge satisfied ->0

rows.budget_ref: 50=33L+17U,222 updates/epoch,11100 optimizer/EMA/physicalclip steps; original U stage963900 packets; actual cache reads measured; no extra model forward for new features
rows.command: LOCAL_BASE_PYTHON -X utf8 -u -m experiments.cvs_f_rxmargin50.driver --profile LOCAL_PROFILE --metadata LOCAL_SOURCE_NATIVE_GATE_METADATA_R02 --base LOCAL_RUN/20261019-phase1-FcrossRX-RXmargin-e50-clean-local-m1-r01 --reference-base LOCAL_RUN/20261019-phase1-FcrossRX-TXrisk-geometry-e50-clean-local-m4-r01 --commit RELEASE_COMMIT --max-workers 3

notes: Original50=33L+17U,11100 updates, original F+CROSS_RX shallow/middle objectives, oldgate/ownEMA/cos,RDrop1,ordinaryAug,LS.01,physical Sinc units/clipping/origin decay unchanged. No satellite augmentation; only clean168000 test; default head jointly trained, no separate head fitting.

Source-only full3 model geometry showed relative RX drift and small outRX low-tail interclass gap; all-class symmetric margin mechanism is fixed before new candidate target access. Prior benchmark outcomes already exposed: exploratory, not new blind confirmation.

For each actual L joint160 anchor: positives sameTX/differentRX, hard negative highest cosine among differentTX/sameRX. Softmin of positive cosines uses temp.05 with count normalization. Class-balanced mean relu(.05+hardnegative-softpositive). Satisfied margins get zero gradient. Maxlambda.1, warm5/ramp10 exactly original schedule. No class weights, V prototypes, fitted projection, extra head, extra model forwards or deploy parameters.

Initial only seed2026092701 candidate scratch50. Reuse already completed exact matching local BASE seeds; no duplicated control training/prediction/scoring. Before new target access freeze source promotion: source-fixed weak2 (14-7,20-19) meanrecall>=+.2pp,overall>=-.2pp,worstRX>=-.5pp,anyTX>=-1pp vs same-seed BASE. On PASS expand candidate unchanged seeds2026092702/03; otherwise retain n1.

Firstseed is a fixed falsification row and always gets clean test after freeze, even source failure; conditional extra rows only follow source rule. Predictions fixed per row before independent CPU truth-last score. No target tuning/reordering/selection/retry; all negatives retained.

Existing healthy original8 row run continues unchanged. New dispatcher prioritizes frozen row clean prediction before filling GPU slots with seed extensions. CPU scorer observes other score processes.

Checks include independent finite/nonempty NumPy angle oracle, satisfied-margin zero gradient, class permutation,7protocol negatives, actual F/RDrop capture/gradient/export/EMA boundary, real final50 noquery smoke. Failed test-only RX grouping and reference path were fixed before release; no real training used those checks.
Exclusive Minimal workflow only; one independent P0/P1 review, no extra approvals/seals/hash chains. Native local release/compile/postlaunch evidence; no N607 actions.
